events: Do-yoon regresses after remembering a liquidation he helped write later selling for forty times scrap value.
He is sent to photograph 삼진콜드 for a quick scrap-sale report and is left outside the creditor meeting room.
He identifies that cold-chain certification, dawn delivery route, recall insurance claim, and port cold-storage priority remain alive.
He uses temperature logs and delivery claims to win meeting-seat and 24-hour data-room access.
He proves an insurance trigger through recall clauses and temperature deviation records, forcing insurer preliminary recognition.
He contacts the large-mart buyer and reframes the route as a delivery continuity problem rather than a dead-company problem.
A scrap buyer and accounting-firm partner try to bury or steal the proof.
Do-yoon proposes an SPV that takes certification, route, insurance claim, and port priority without swallowing the whole dead burden.
He wins priority negotiation and turnaround plan submission right.
He secures first temporary transport order and a next distressed food-factory data-room invitation.
npc_candidates: 한도윤 - protagonist; self-interested restructuring examiner and distressed-rights buyer.
회계법인 파트너 - internal credit thief and liability shifter.
채권은행 구조조정팀장 - creditor gatekeeper whose calculation changes when recovery rate improves.
보험사 손해사정 담당자 - payment minimizer forced by clause/log proof.
대형마트 구매담당자 - external evaluator who needs dawn-delivery continuity.
삼진콜드 창고장 또는 운송반장 - route memory holder and operational proof asset.
고철업자 - opening counterparty who wants quick scrap bundling.
대형 PEF 파트너 - later predator trying to absorb the portfolio.
crisis_candidates: Scrap sale deadline scatters the living rights.
Creditor committee blocks full data-room access.
Large-mart buyer threatens to move the route to a competitor.
Scrap buyer bids for the trucks to destroy certification continuity.
Accounting partner tries to steal credit and leave Do-yoon with liability.
Advisory conflict threatens legal cleanliness of acquisition.
Core drivers leave, weakening route memory and certification maintenance.
PEF later attempts to buy the portfolio after proof has been de-risked.
scene_details: Meeting-room threshold scene: Do-yoon stands outside as a disposable field examiner before proving the bank needs him inside.
Warehouse proof scene: broken refrigerated trucks are visually unimpressive, but the temperature log and claim timing reveal certification survival.
Insurance proof scene: insurer tries to deny payment until Do-yoon matches clause wording with actual temperature deviation records.
Buyer call scene: large-mart buyer cares about dawn-delivery continuity, not pity for a bankrupt company.
Port cold-storage scene: priority-use schedule proves the company still controls a bottleneck competitors missed.
SPV table scene: Do-yoon refuses whole-company rescue and isolates certification, route, insurance claim, and storage priority as the acquisition target.
First cashflow scene: temporary transport order lands after authority, proving rights-before-cash pacing.
Next-gate scene: bank invites Do-yoon into the next distressed food-factory data room.
notes: Stage 0 material is sufficient for Phase 0. The opening macro battlefield is 삼진콜드 cold-chain distressed acquisition. The strongest risks are legality/conflict-of-interest handwave, charity-rescue drift, and too-thin TR blocks; these are explicitly locked as constraints.

opening_bundle_contract.bundle_goal: Turn Do-yoon from disposable field examiner into the clean priority negotiator who controls 삼진콜드's living rights bundle and receives the next distressed deal invitation.
opening_bundle_contract.timing_reconciliation_note: TR 2~6 is the reader-earning opening bundle, not five single episodes. Each block must carry at least two incident beats and same-block receipt so the later manuscript can unfold quickly into 2-6 episodes per block without padding.
